mapper.select: SELECT SYSTEM_ID AS SYSTEM_ID, SYSTEM_NAME AS SYSTEM_NAME, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_BIZ_SYSTEM_PILOT WHERE SYSTEM_ID LIKE 'SYS-%' ORDER BY SYSTEM_ID

SELECT DOMAIN_CD AS DOMAIN_CD, SYSTEM_ID AS SYSTEM_ID, NAME_KO AS NAME_KO, NAME_EN AS NAME_EN, SORT_NO AS SORT_NO FROM TB_IF_BIZ_DOMAIN_PILOT WHERE ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND SYSTEM_ID = #{systemId} ORDER BY SORT_NO, DOMAIN_CD

SELECT BIZ_CD AS BIZ_CD, DOMAIN_CD AS DOMAIN_CD, NAME_KO AS NAME_KO, NAME_EN AS NAME_EN, SORT_NO AS SORT_NO FROM TB_IF_BIZ_UNIT_PILOT WHERE ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND DOMAIN_CD = #{domainCd} ORDER BY SORT_NO, BIZ_CD

SELECT DETAIL_CD AS DETAIL_CD, BIZ_CD AS BIZ_CD, FUNCTION_CD AS FUNCTION_CD, NAME_KO AS NAME_KO, SORT_NO AS SORT_NO FROM TB_IF_BIZ_DETAIL_PILOT WHERE ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND BIZ_CD = #{bizCd} ORDER BY SORT_NO, DETAIL_CD

SELECT D.DETAIL_CD AS DETAIL_CD, D.BIZ_CD AS BIZ_CD, D.FUNCTION_CD AS FUNCTION_CD, D.NAME_KO AS NAME_KO, D.SORT_NO AS SORT_NO, U.DOMAIN_CD AS DOMAIN_CD, U.NAME_KO AS BIZ_NAME, U.NAME_EN AS BIZ_NAME_EN FROM TB_IF_BIZ_DETAIL_PILOT D INNER JOIN TB_IF_BIZ_UNIT_PILOT U ON U.BIZ_CD = D.BIZ_CD AND U.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' INNER JOIN TB_IF_BIZ_DOMAIN_PILOT DM ON DM.DOMAIN_CD = U.DOMAIN_CD AND DM.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' WHERE D.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND DM.SYSTEM_ID = #{systemId} AND U.DOMAIN_CD = #{domainCd} ORDER BY U.SORT_NO, D.SORT_NO, D.DETAIL_CD

SELECT DB_ID AS DB_ID, DB_NAME AS DB_NAME, ENGINE_CD AS ENGINE_CD, VERSION_NO AS VERSION_NO, ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, SYSTEM_ID AS SYSTEM_ID, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_DB_INSTANCE_PILOT WHERE 1=1 AND SYSTEM_ID = #{systemId} ORDER BY DB_ID

SELECT MW.MW_ID AS MW_ID, MW.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, MW.VERSION_NO AS VERSION_NO, MW.ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, MW.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_MW_INSTALL_PILOT MW INNER JOIN TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT A ON A.ASSET_ID = MW.ASSET_ID WHERE 1=1 AND A.SYSTEM_ID = #{systemId} ORDER BY MW.PRODUCT_NAME, MW.MW_ID

SELECT APP_ID AS APP_ID, APP_NAME AS APP_NAME, SYSTEM_ID AS SYSTEM_ID, DETAIL_CD AS DETAIL_CD, APP_TYPE_CD AS APP_TYPE_CD, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, LANG_CD AS LANG_CD, REMARK AS REMARK FROM TB_IF_APPLICATION_PILOT WHERE APP_ID = #{appId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_APP_MAP_PILOT M INNER JOIN TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT A ON A.ASSET_ID = M.REF_ID WHERE M.APP_ID = #{appId} AND M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'SERVER' AND A.STATUS_CD = 'DELETED'

SELECT A.APP_ID AS APP_ID, A.APP_NAME AS APP_NAME, A.SYSTEM_ID AS SYSTEM_ID, A.DETAIL_CD AS DETAIL_CD, A.APP_TYPE_CD AS APP_TYPE_CD, A.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, A.LANG_CD AS LANG_CD, A.REMARK AS REMARK FROM TB_IF_APPLICATION_PILOT A WHERE 1=1 AND A.SYSTEM_ID = #{systemId}
AND (',' || REPLACE(NVL(A.APP_TYPE_CD,''), ' ', '') || ',' LIKE '%,' || #{appTypeCd} || ',%')
AND (UPPER(NVL(A.APP_ID,'')) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{appKeyword})||'%' OR UPPER(NVL(A.APP_NAME,'')) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{appKeyword})||'%' OR UPPER(NVL(A.APP_TYPE_CD,'')) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{appKeyword})||'%')
ORDER BY A.APP_ID

SELECT M.MAP_ID AS MAP_ID, M.APP_ID AS APP_ID, M.MAP_TYPE_CD AS MAP_TYPE_CD, M.REF_ID AS REF_ID, M.ROLE_CD AS ROLE_CD, M.PRIMARY_YN AS PRIMARY_YN, M.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, M.GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID, M.REMARK AS REMARK, CASE WHEN M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'SERVER' THEN NVL(A.ASSET_NAME, M.REF_ID) WHEN M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'GROUP' THEN NVL(G.GROUP_NAME, M.REF_ID) WHEN M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'DB' THEN NVL(D.DB_NAME, M.REF_ID) ELSE M.REF_ID END AS REF_NAME, NVL(M.GROUP_ID, CASE WHEN M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'GROUP' THEN M.REF_ID ELSE A.GROUP_ID END) AS RESOLVED_GROUP_ID FROM TB_IF_APP_MAP_PILOT M LEFT JOIN TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT A ON M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'SERVER' AND A.ASSET_ID = M.REF_ID LEFT JOIN TB_IF_SERVER_GROUP_PILOT G ON M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'GROUP' AND G.GROUP_ID = M.REF_ID LEFT JOIN TB_IF_DB_INSTANCE_PILOT D ON M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'DB' AND D.DB_ID = M.REF_ID WHERE 1=1 AND M.APP_ID = #{appId} ORDER BY M.MAP_TYPE_CD, M.MAP_ID

SELECT A.ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, A.ASSET_NAME AS ASSET_NAME, A.GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID, A.TECH_ROLE_CD AS TECH_ROLE_CD, A.ENV_CD AS ENV_CD, A.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, EP.ADDRESS AS IP_ADDR, EP.PORT_NO AS PORT_NO FROM TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT A LEFT JOIN TB_IF_NETWORK_EP_PILOT EP ON EP.ASSET_ID = A.ASSET_ID AND NVL(EP.PRIMARY_YN,'N') = 'Y' WHERE A.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND NVL(A.STATUS_CD,'') <> 'DELETED' ORDER BY A.ASSET_ID

SELECT EP.ENDPOINT_ID AS ENDPOINT_ID, EP.ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, A.ASSET_NAME AS ASSET_NAME, EP.ENDPOINT_TYPE_CD AS ENDPOINT_TYPE_CD, EP.ADDRESS AS ADDRESS, EP.PORT_NO AS PORT_NO, EP.PROTOCOL_CD AS PROTOCOL_CD, EP.PRIMARY_YN AS PRIMARY_YN FROM TB_IF_NETWORK_EP_PILOT EP INNER JOIN TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT A ON A.ASSET_ID = EP.ASSET_ID INNER JOIN TB_IF_APP_MAP_PILOT M ON ((M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'SERVER' AND M.REF_ID = EP.ASSET_ID) OR (M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'GROUP' AND M.REF_ID = A.GROUP_ID)) WHERE M.APP_ID = #{appId} ORDER BY EP.PRIMARY_YN DESC, EP.ENDPOINT_ID

SELECT ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME AS ASSET_NAME, GROUP_ID AS GROUP_ID, TECH_ROLE_CD AS TECH_ROLE_CD, ENV_CD AS ENV_CD, STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD FROM TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId}

SELECT DISTINCT MW.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, MW.VERSION_NO AS VERSION_NO, MW.ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID FROM TB_IF_MW_INSTALL_PILOT MW INNER JOIN TB_IF_APP_MAP_PILOT M ON M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'SERVER' AND M.REF_ID = MW.ASSET_ID WHERE M.APP_ID = #{appId} ORDER BY MW.PRODUCT_NAME

SELECT M.REF_ID AS DB_ID, NVL(D.DB_NAME, M.REF_ID) AS DB_NAME, D.ENGINE_CD AS ENGINE_CD, D.VERSION_NO AS VERSION_NO FROM TB_IF_APP_MAP_PILOT M LEFT JOIN TB_IF_DB_INSTANCE_PILOT D ON D.DB_ID = M.REF_ID WHERE M.APP_ID = #{appId} AND M.MAP_TYPE_CD = 'DB' ORDER BY M.MAP_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_APP_MAP_PILOT WHERE APP_ID = #{appId} AND MAP_TYPE_CD = #{mapTypeCd} AND REF_ID = #{refId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_IF_APP_MAP_PILOT WHERE APP_ID = #{appId} AND MAP_TYPE_CD = 'SERVER' AND PRIMARY_YN = 'Y'
